notes:
- Feature: "Why no signal" telemetry (Log tab and Copy diagnostics). Per pair and strategy, per minute for the last hour plus the session: candles closed, checked, warming up, not seen completely; what blocked each one (score, missing mandatory item and which, both sides, each AVOID rule, repeat, news); how often each confirmation passed; signals and signals per hour; trades and skip reasons; candles held, unbroken run, ticks, socket breaks, repairs.
- Literal texts: every SNIPER text lists "News/high volatility" under AVOID, so all nine now pause around high-impact news (was 5S only) and have a high-volatility rule (ATR(14) above 2x its 100-candle average). 30M text "Weak structure" is now an AVOID rule (the structure leading into the setup must step in the trade direction). Each is a Settings switch, on by default.
- Feature: Settings -> Rule definitions. Every number the texts leave open is one shared, adjustable list with the old values as defaults: ADX for sideways (20), EMA chop (2 crosses in 20 candles), mid-range (40-60% of the last 30 candles), strong rejection (wick 50%, close in the outer 40%), weak candle (body under 0.25 ATR), abnormal spike (range over 3 ATR), high volatility (2x average ATR over 100 candles), strong S/R (2 swing points within 0.3 ATR). Used by SNIPER, Confluence, RSI + Stoch + S/R and BB + Stoch alike. docs/STRATEGY-DEFINITIONS.md lists every definition for approval; docs/CLIENT-STRATEGY-TEXTS.md holds the texts verbatim.
- Feature: tools/backtest-otc.js measures SNIPER 5S / 15S / 30S / 1M on recorded OTC candles too, with each strategy's own expiry.
- Docs: measured signal rates replace "the first trade can take 1 to 30 minutes"; the root cause of the rare live SNIPER signals (reconnect holes resetting warm-up, fixed in 0.10.2) is in docs/FINDINGS.md.
